create.name: Matthew Duplessie
create.bio:
Matthew Duplessie is a voice and sound teacher, musician and Kundalini Yoga practitioner based in Savannah, Georgia, where he runs AudioSoul Healing. He studied motion media and sound design at the Savannah College of Art and Design and later trained in Kundalini Yoga, holistic voice therapy, Reiki and life coaching. As a recording artist, also known as Matthew Jaidev, he builds devotional and world music from layered vocals, throat singing, chant, drums and didgeridoo, and he narrates spiritual audiobooks.

His teaching rests on the idea that everyone's natural voice can become a tool for presence and self-expression, singer or not. In one-to-one holistic voice sessions, held in Savannah or over video, he combines toning, mantra, breath, movement and meditation to help people reconnect with their own sound and speak more freely. His online courses cover sound healing with the voice, vowel and chakra toning, and finding an authentic voice, and on YouTube he shares Kundalini meditations, guided journeys and talks on the Aquarian Age. On Insight Timer he offers sonic journeys, drumming activations and two voice courses, and he also writes personal mantras and composes custom meditation music.

courses.title: Holistic Voice Therapy Single Session
courses.description: A one-hour private session in Savannah or by video, working with toning, mantra, breath and movement to reconnect with your natural voice. Bundles of three and eight sessions are also offered.

courses.title: The Power of Sound Healing with Voice 10-Day Video Course
courses.description: Ten guided video lessons introducing sound, resonance and intention, with practice in vowel chanting, mantra, affirmations and chakra toning. No singing experience is needed.

courses.title: The Power of Sound Healing with Voice (Audio Course)
courses.description: The audio-only edition of his ten-day voice course, for practising toning and chant away from a screen.

courses.title: Discovering Your Authentic Voice
courses.description: An eight-day Insight Timer course on releasing self-judgement and finding your own way of speaking and sounding.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: The Power Of Sound Healing Through Voice
courses.description: A ten-day Insight Timer course of daily voice practices, from simple humming and vowels to mantra.
